_comment: tests/nas (story 59.15): a kernel without Landlock and without user namespaces, as on most DSM models.
landlock_* answer ENOSYS (38): a kernel built without it;
unshare answers EPERM (1); clone with CLONE_NEWUSER (0x10000000) answers EPERM; clone3 answers ENOSYS (38), as Docker's default profile does, so callers fall back to clone.
Everything else is allowed: the cell tests what Maktaba does without these, not Docker's whole default profile.
